findings.title: 已存在一個required基線，另有一個未宣告核心規則前提
findings.detail: python-web-scraping明確強制讀python-development，符合metadata；document-to-markdown要求每次conversion套用markdown-writer規則，metadata尚無依賴。後者需要明确required或自有fallback決策，不应由installer研究立即改動。

evidence.text: Before planning or editing a Python scraper, read the sibling [`../python-development/SKILL.md`](../python-development/SKILL.md), even when the runtime omitted it from the initial Skill list. Keep this skill responsible for fetch, parse, pagination, normalization, retry, deduplication, and crawl behavior; keep `python-development` responsible for Python modules, typing, errors, resource lifetime, package boundaries, and general implementation.
- Use manual cleanup plus `markdown-writer` rules after every conversion, even when the converter succeeds.

findings.title: image-utils有明確但未宣告的多資產分支
findings.detail: 只有多cut-out/density/bounds/manifest要求須同用image-to-code-assets；單張resize/crop可以独立。

evidence.text: description: Deterministic image post-processing for resizing, cropping, compositing, format conversion, optimization, watermarks, and predictable pixel-level edits. Keep simple single-image operations here. For UI design-image or screenshot requests that require multiple independent cut-out assets, transparency, 2x/3x/4x density, bounding boxes, or a manifest, also load image-to-code-assets.

findings.title: Spec中的reverse-engineering只是普通動詞，不是同名binary Skill依賴
findings.detail: specification-authoring自有code-to-Spec inventory/ref mapping；本文未要求讀取reverse-engineering Skill。名稱候選此項已排除。

evidence.text: Read this when the task is **reverse-engineering** or **scanning code** to produce a **技術規格說明書**, not when you are only editing prose in an already-structured Spec.

limits: 唯讀語義研究；未修改Skills、catalog、installer，未執行模型eval、生成provider/API、真實安裝或受審查package的腳本。
76份SKILL.md已完整讀取。直接引用runtime資源先以共用inventory檢查sibling候選；涉及sibling/phase gate及三個實作腳本已全文核讀，inspectedFiles僅記實際讀過的檔案。
Required與conditional是本文語義，不等於目前installer行為；目前declaredDependencies由主報告從inventory另列。本分區目前僅python-web-scraping required與git-readme-writer conditional兩筆宣告。
Skill-scan/security的有效report可消費；executor/forge前置run與reuse政策不足明處列ambiguities，不把同群或名稱提及全部升級為必裝。
standalone限定sibling composition。yes表示至少一個完整primary output可獨立完成；外部工具前提、有效既有artifact或擴展/特殊格式conditional不造成降級。base-only只保留完整交付必須路由到所選stage專項的orchestrator；unclear保留硬性載入與有效artifact替代政策不足的項目。
groupTags為既有routingGroups加提議用途標籤，不是已發布install profile，也不應形成相關Skills的全部聯集。
少數conditional條目是明確後續/交付分支的生產器；只在該分支為所需成果、且缺合格既有artifact時考慮補裝。alternative是改走另一主要owner，不是required一起安裝。
未驗證外部model/provider/CLI的現行能力、價格、SDK版本或安裝可用性；externalPrerequisites根據本文所有權與工具需求，不是實測結果。
standaloneEvidence為本次補充欄位：每Skill保留核心或安裝前提的one-based來源證據，避免無relationship的獨立Skill缺少可回查依據。
